intent: Technical Brief: ASUS ROG Zephyrus G15 (2022) System State Baseline
suggested_solution: Obtain dump files from the BSOD to analyze the crash logs.
Attempt a barebones boot with minimal components to rule out faulty peripherals.
Consider removing the battery as a last resort.
Approach ASUS support and inquire about goodwill or out-of-warranty repair options.
